records.jp: 伶那さん
records.en_original: Rena?
records.en: Rena-san?

records.jp: ……あ、ごめん。ぼーっとしてた
records.en_original: Oh... Sorry. I must have spaced out.
records.en: Oh... Sorry. I must have spaced out.

records.jp: 伶那さんでも、ぼーっとすることあるんだ
records.en_original: I didn't think you were the type to space out, Rena.
records.en: I didn't think you were the type to space out, Rena-san.

records.jp: あるよ。バレないようにこっそりしてる
records.en_original: I do sometimes. I'm usually better at hiding it, though.
records.en: I do sometimes. I'm usually better at hiding it, though.

records.jp: ふふ、こっそりなんだ
records.en_original: Hehe, why would you want to hide it?
records.en: Hehe, why would you want to hide it?

records.jp: だって、一応みんなの中では年上の方だし。<CR>ぼーっとしてたら頼りないでしょ
records.en_original: I'm one of the oldest ones here. If people see me spacing out, I'd look unreliable.
records.en: I'm one of the oldest ones here. If people see me spacing out, I'd look unreliable.

records.jp: たまにはそういう隙を見せるのもいいと思うけど
records.en_original: I think it's okay to let people see that side of you sometimes, though.
records.en: I think it's okay to let people see that side of you sometimes, though.

records.jp: ……考えとく
records.en_original: ...I'll think about it.
records.en: ...I'll think about it.

records.jp: ごめん、邪魔しちゃって
records.en_original: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt.
records.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt.

records.jp: 別に遠慮しないで声かけていいから
records.en_original: Don't worry about it.
records.en: Don't worry about it.

records.jp: 邪魔だと思ってたら連れてこないし。<CR>こうやってゆるく喋るのも好きだから
records.en_original: If I didn't want to be interrupted I wouldn't have brought you along. I like our casual chats.
records.en: If I didn't want to be interrupted I wouldn't have brought you along. I like our casual chats.

records.jp: へー、そっか。<CR>意外だけど……私と一緒だ
records.en_original: Oh really... We have more in common than I thought.
records.en: Oh really... We have more in common than I thought.

records.jp: よくここには来てるの？
records.en_original: Do you often come up here?
records.en: Do you often come up here?

records.jp: うん、大体一人で
records.en_original: Yeah, usually alone.
records.en: Yeah, usually alone.

records.jp: なんで今日は私を連れてきてくれたの？
records.en_original: So why did you bring me today?
records.en: So why did you bring me today?

records.jp: なんでだろ……こういう面もあるって<CR>星崎さんには知ってほしかったのかも
records.en_original: Good question... Maybe I wanted you to know that there was another side to me, Hoshizaki.
records.en: Good question... Maybe I wanted you to know that there was another side to me, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 嬉しいなぁ。なんか心を開いてもらってる気がして
records.en_original: Aww, I'm glad. I feel like you're opening up to me.
records.en: Aww, I'm glad. I feel like you're opening up to me.

records.jp: そんなに私って閉じてるように見える？
records.en_original: Was I closed off before?
records.en: Was I closed off before?

records.jp: その……あまり本心とか弱いところとか<CR>見せないようにしてるのかなって思ってたから
records.en_original: I guess I always saw you as someone who doesn't like to seem vulnerable or show their true feelings.
records.en: I guess I always saw you as someone who doesn't like to seem vulnerable or show their true feelings.

records.jp: 私にはバンバン見せてもらっていいからね。<CR>実は一日中寝巻の日もあるとか
records.en_original: You don't have to hide anything from me. Even if you actually spend the whole day in your pajamas sometimes.
records.en: You don't have to hide anything from me. Even if you actually spend the whole day in your pajamas sometimes.

records.jp: そういうだらしない面はありません
records.en_original: I would never.
records.en: I would never.

records.jp: あはは、さすがにそっか
records.en_original: Ahaha, of course not.
records.en: Ahaha, of course not.

records.jp: 実は知ってました
records.en_original: Actually, I already knew that.
records.en: Actually, I already knew that.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: いや、さっきは意外だなって思ったんだけど<CR>よく考えたら伶那さんらしい気がする
records.en_original: At first I didn't think it was like you, but now I realize that it totally is.
records.en: At first I was surprised, but thinking about it, it actually feels very like you, Rena-san.

records.jp: 普段しっかりしてる人こそ、<CR>こういう休憩時間が必要だと思うし
records.en_original: People who seem like they've got it all together are the ones who need time to unwind the most.
records.en: People who seem like they've got it all together are the ones who need time to unwind the most.

records.jp: ……むかつく
records.en_original: ...Unbelievable.
records.en: ...Unbelievable.

records.jp: なんでよ
records.en_original: What...?
records.en: What...?

records.jp: そうやって私のことわかった感じで<CR>優しいこと言ってくるから
records.en_original: The way you talk to me is like...like you truly know me.
records.en: The way you talk to me is like...like you truly know me.

records.jp: へへへ
records.en_original: Hehehe.
records.en: Hehehe.

records.jp: 私、今ぼーっとしてるから<CR>普段言えないこと、言ってもいいよ
records.en_original: I'm totally spaced out right now, so you can tell me something you normally wouldn't.
records.en: I'm totally spaced out right now, so you can tell me something you normally wouldn't.

records.jp: 今なら怒らないと思う。多分
records.en_original: I won't get mad. ...Probably.
records.en: I won't get mad. ...Probably.

records.jp: 普段言えないことかぁ
records.en_original: Something I normally wouldn't tell you... Hmmm...
records.en: Something I normally wouldn't tell you... Hmmm...

records.jp: 前から思ってたんだけど……
records.en_original: There was one thing...
records.en: There was one thing...

records.jp: 伶那さん時々、「ひと段落」って言うじゃん
records.en_original: You know how you sometimes say "case and point"?
records.en: You know how you sometimes say "case and point," Rena-san?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: あれ、本当は「一（いち）段落」って<CR>読むんだよ
records.en_original: It's actually "case IN point."
records.en: It's actually "case IN point."

records.jp: え！？　そうなの！？
records.en_original: What?! Seriously?!
records.en: What?! Seriously?!

records.jp: 話し言葉で使ってる人もいるし、指摘するのも<CR>野暮かなぁと思ってたんだけど
records.en_original: I always felt awkward pointing it out...
records.en: I always felt awkward pointing it out...

records.jp: 伶那さん、そういうのちゃんとしておきたいタイプな<CR>気がしたから、一応伝えとく
records.en_original: But I felt like that's something you'd want to know, so I had to tell you.
records.en: But you seem like the type who'd want to get that kind of thing right, Rena-san, so I thought I should tell you.

records.jp: うそ……ずっと勘違いしてた……
records.en_original: You're kidding... I've been saying it wrong this whole time...
records.en: You're kidding... I've been saying it wrong this whole time...

records.jp: しかも年下の星崎さんに言われるなんて……
records.en_original: And Hoshizaki was the one to point it out...
records.en: And Hoshizaki-san was the one to point it out...

records.jp: 私は親近感持ったけどね。<CR>伶那さんでもそういうことあるんだって
records.en_original: It made me feel closer to you, though. Knowing that even Rena makes mistakes sometimes.
records.en: It made me feel closer to you, though. Knowing that even you make mistakes sometimes, Rena-san.

records.jp: 教えてくれたのはありがとう。<CR>でもすぐ忘れて……！
records.en_original: Thanks for letting me know. Now wipe this conversation from your memory!
records.en: Thanks for letting me know. Now wipe this conversation from your memory!

records.jp: ごめん、実はこの前のプリン……
records.en_original: Actually, I do have something to tell you... I was the one who ate your pudding. I'm sorry.
records.en: Actually, I do have something to tell you... I was the one who ate your pudding. I'm sorry.

records.jp: ああ、私のプリン食べちゃったの？<CR>いいよ、そのくらい
records.en_original: Ah, that was you? That's fine, I'll let it slide.
records.en: Ah, that was you? That's fine, I'll let it slide.

records.jp: それと、この前のケーキ……
records.en_original: The pudding...and the cake...
records.en: The pudding...and the cake...

records.jp: ケーキなんて作られてたの？<CR>まあ、知らなかったくらいだし、いいよそれも
records.en_original: There was cake? Well, I didn't even know about it, so that's fine too.
records.en: There was cake? Well, I didn't even know about it, so that's fine too.

records.jp: あと、その前のクッキー……
records.en_original: Also...the cookies...
records.en: Also...the cookies...

records.jp: え、多くない？
records.en_original: Seriously? That's a bit much, isn't it?
records.en: Seriously? That's a bit much, isn't it?

records.jp: ごめん！<CR>我慢できなくて！
records.en_original: I'm sorry! I couldn't resist!
records.en: I'm sorry! I couldn't resist!

records.jp: わかったわかった。<CR>掃除当番、一回代わってくれたらチャラにしてあげる
records.en_original: Well, okay. I'll let you off the hook if you take over my cleaning duties one time.
records.en: Well, okay. I'll let you off the hook if you take over my cleaning duties one time.

records.jp: よかったぁ～……そのくらいなら頑張ります
records.en_original: Phew... I think I can handle that.
records.en: Phew... I think I can handle that.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
